title: Bupa Dental Care launches international exchange programme for dental nurses in UK and Australia
html:
Colleagues across Bupa’s global dental network will have the opportunity to gain international experience through a newly launched dental nurse exchange programme, enabling them to work alongside colleagues around the Bupa world to develop their careers and skills.

Dental nurses Hannah Foster from Bupa Dental Care Bramhall and Amy Connolly from Bupa Dental Care Stockbridge are among the first colleagues selected to take part in the fully funded six-week placement with Bupa Dental Care Australia.

Starting in February 2027, the new programme will also welcome two dental nurses from Bupa Dental Care Australia to work in Bupa Dental Care practices in the UK. During their placements, colleagues will shadow local teams, share knowledge, explore different approaches to patient care and collaborate on a shared project.

‘Dental nurses play a vital role in delivering quality care to our patients, and we’re committed to creating opportunities that recognise their contribution and support their career development. This programme gives colleagues the chance to connect, exchange ideas and gain fresh insights from teams the other side of the world, helping them broaden their skills and experience. The interest in the new programme has been fantastic, and we’re delighted for Hannah and Amy as they prepare for this exciting experience. It’s a brilliant example of how a career in dental nursing can open doors to global opportunities.’ Amelia Hodgson Head of dental nursing, Bupa Dental Care ‘I was so happy when I received the news. I can’t wait to meet people from different practices, hear about their experiences and see the different ways teams work. It’ll be a great opportunity to build new professional relationships, share ideas and learn from others across the profession. I’m really looking forward to bringing new insights back to my practice.’ Hannah Foster Bupa Dental Care Bramhall ‘I’m so excited for this opportunity and being part of such an amazing experience. It’s something I’m very grateful for and can’t wait to make the most of it.’ Amy Connolly Bupa Dental Care Stockbridge

For more information on careers at Bupa Dental Care, you can visit: jobs.bupadentalcare.co.uk.
